reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows through incomplete sanitization (only *, (, ) replaced) into LDAP filter string via concatenation. Resolved sink value: '(uid=<tainted_user_input>)'. Many LDAP metacharacters (&, |, !, <, >, =, ,, [, ], {, }) remain unescaped, allowing injection attacks.

evidence.note: User param flows through replace() calls that miss critical LDAP operators (&, |, !, <, >, =, ,, [, ], {, }), then concatenated into filter string used in ctx.search()
